Did it flip? 📈 2 of last week's 6 drops made money on eBay after fees

Our calls before release: 2 of 3 right ✅

1. Travis Scott x Nike Air Force 1 Low "GTA 6" "White": $130 retail → $325 eBay (+$144) · Flipped
2. Travis Scott x Nike Air Force 1 Low "GTA 6" "Black": $130 retail → $315 eBay (+$134) · Flipped
3. Nike Kobe 9 EM Low Protro "Philippines": $200 retail → $249 eBay (−$2) · Wash (we said Cop)
4. Nike Kobe AD Protro "Purple Stardust": $155 retail → $166 eBay (−$30) · Bricked (we said Drop)
5. Air Jordan 3 "Not Nice": $215 retail → $180 eBay (−$82) · Bricked (we said Cop to wear)
6. Nike Mind 002 Flyknit "Dark Smoke Grey": $145 retail → $81 eBay (−$101) · Bricked

eBay = median sold price (5+ sales) or the low end of new pairs listed. Profit after ~8% tax, eBay fees and shipping. Prices vary by size and change fast.

Did you cop any of these? 👇 Think we got one wrong? Tell us.
